title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
summary: Choose a contiguous substring and change up to k of its letters to other uppercase English letters.

contractDetails.constraints: The string has 1–100,000 uppercase English letters. The replacement budget k lies between zero and the string length.

statement: Choose a contiguous substring and change up to k of its letters to other uppercase English letters. Return the largest length you can make uniform.

examples.explanation: Replacing D and A makes all six letters C.
PQPP can become PPPP with one change.
The three consecutive M's are already uniform.

constraints: The string has 1–100,000 uppercase English letters. The replacement budget k lies between zero and the string length.
hints: Conceptual: For a fixed stretch, keep its most common letter and change the rest.
Directional: Track the count of each letter inside a moving window.
Implementation: If window length minus its largest count exceeds k, move the left edge inward. Save the widest feasible window.
complexityAnalysis: O(26n) time and O(26) auxiliary space, both O(n) time and O(1) space for the fixed alphabet. You can scan all 26 counts after each change.
